items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: it was mentioned that this was when I first met Georgie Lee. He used to come in there, and they had opened up a great million-dollar ballroom called the Frog Hop Ballroom, and Georgie Lee heard them

ctx.x: But where was Jesse Stone really from?

Jesse Stone is from Atchison, Kansas, which is 32 miles away from Saint Joseph, Missouri. And on the way between -- see, Jesse Stone, Jesse Stone's family was with a medicine show, his father and grandfather. So his grandfather had a farm in Atchison, Kansas, and we visited his farm, and on the way to the farm there was one of Jesse James' caves that we used to go in and see, between Atchison and Saint Joseph, Missouri.

But anyway, we had this band. Now when we came into Saint Joseph, Missouri with this band, after we had gotten rid of T. Holder, we checked into the Charlotte Hotel, which is a black hotel owned by a woman that Jesse Stone knew, and she gave us two rooms. We had fourteen pieces, so there was seven to a room. The first three or four that hit the bed could sleep in that. The rest of us had to kind of stick on the floor and in the chairs.
